messages:
Lina (Docs): Quick heads-up: we are renaming the main SDK client from `RedwoodClient` -> `InferenceClient` across all official SDKs and in the docs. This affects examples, quickstarts, and code snippets.
Lina (Docs): Why: name better reflects the product surface and reduces ambiguity with internal packages.
Lina (Docs): Timeline: compatibility shim in minor releases starting next week, deprecation warning for 3 months, full removal in v5.0 (major) in ~90 days. Migration guide & automated codemods linked below.
Tom (PM): +1 on the rename. What exactly will the shim do?
Raj (SDK Eng): Shim will alias `RedwoodClient` to `InferenceClient` and emit a one-line deprecation warning on construction. Languages: Python/JS/Go/Rust.
Raj (SDK Eng): We'll land shim in v4.2.1 (patch) so folks upgrading don't break immediately. Full removal scheduled for v5.0.
Mira (Releases): Roll plan: publish v4.2.1 (shims + docs) next Tue. Docs site will show both names during the deprecation window with a banner.
Lina (Docs): Migration snippet in the guide:

```python
# before
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))

# after
client = InferenceClient(api_key=os.getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))
```

Lina (Docs): We've added a codemod for Python/JS that will bulk-replace imports and construction; link: https://go.redwood/codemods/inferenceclient-migrate (PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/432)
Andy (Eng): Will CI linting on internal repos fail because of the rename?
Raj (SDK Eng): No — for the 3-month window the shim keeps the old symbol available. Lint rules that pin to exact class names will need updating after removal. We'll add a CI note in the release notes.
Zoe (QA): Any behavior changes or surface-level API changes besides the name?
Raj (SDK Eng): No runtime behavior changes. We intentionally kept the constructor signature identical; only class name changes and docs.
Tom (PM): Action items: docs to update quickstarts (Lina), SDKs to ship shims + deprecation warning (Raj), releases to schedule (Mira), outreach email to customers with heavy SDK usage (Tom).
Lina (Docs): I'll open a short FAQ and a section in the migration guide addressing common gotchas (retry wrappers, subclassing, type hints).
Mira (Releases): I'll add an entry to the changelog and the partner update deck.
dev-bot: Release checklist created: https://go.redwood/releases/1719994321 (assignee: @Mira) :sparkles:
Andy (Eng): Will internal infra packages that import `RedwoodClient` from the SDK need a code change?
Raj (SDK Eng): If they vendor the SDK copy, yes. If they import the installed SDK (pip/npm), the shim covers them. We'll ping platform teams separately.
Lina (Docs): ETA for the docs PR to land on the main site is EOD Monday. I'll post a follow-up with exact page slugs.
Tom (PM): Thanks — please add a short blurb to the weekly all-hands notes once the rollout is scheduled.
Lina (Docs): +1. If anyone wants to review the migration guide early: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/432/files
Zoe (QA): I'll add tests to exercise the deprecation warning and ensure no regressions in our sample apps.
Lina (Docs): Thanks all — tagging the SDK folks: @Raj and the releases team @Mira. Please flag any blockers here. :wave:
